lines.text: Jo bikes up a three kilometer hill at twelve kilometers per hour, then back down at ten meters per second.
lines.caption: Jo bikes up a 3 kilometer hill at 12 kilometers per hour, then back down at 10 meters per second.

lines.text: Her average speed, in kilometers per hour?
lines.caption: Her average speed, in kilometers per hour?

lines.text: Ten meters per second is thirty-six kilometers per hour.
lines.caption: 10 meters per second is 36 kilometers per hour.

lines.text: Going up takes fifteen minutes. Going down takes just five.
lines.caption: Going up takes 15 minutes. Going down takes just 5.

lines.text: Six kilometers in twenty minutes, a third of an hour.
lines.caption: 6 kilometers in 20 minutes, a third of an hour.

lines.text: So in one hour, she goes three times as far!
lines.caption: So in one hour, she goes 3 times as far!

lines.text: Six times three is eighteen kilometers per hour!
lines.caption: 6 times 3 is 18 kilometers per hour!

lines.text: Did you get eighteen? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 18? Tell me below!
